instructions: This paper covers the work of Terms 3 and 4.

Read each question carefully before you answer it.
Show your working, and round your answers as each question asks.

sections.title: QUESTION 1: Electrical Systems: Circuits and Components

questions.prompt: Which is an OUTPUT device?
Complete Ohm's law: V = I × …
A 12 V supply is connected to a 6 Ω resistor. Calculate the current.
A current of 0,5 A flows through a 20 Ω resistor. Calculate the voltage across it.
In a parallel circuit, if one bulb blows the others go out.
Classify each component in a torch.
Give ONE advantage and ONE disadvantage of a series circuit.
questions.memo:
✓ Advantage: simple / uses less current, so the battery lasts longer (1)
✓ Disadvantage: if one component fails all stop / bulbs dimmer (1)

questions.prompt: What is a short circuit and why is it dangerous?
questions.memo:
✓ Current takes a path of very low resistance, bypassing the components (1)
✓ A very large current flows and overheats the wires, which can cause a fire (1)

questions.prompt: Two switches in series form which logic circuit?

pairs.right: Heater that switches off if knocked over

questions.prompt: Why does a paper guillotine have two buttons that must be pressed at the same time? Which logic does this use?
questions.memo:
✓ So that both of the operator's hands are away from the blade (safety) (1)
✓ AND logic (1)

questions.prompt: A buzzer must sound if the front door OR the back door of a house is opened. Describe how you would connect the switches and say which type of switch you could use.
questions.memo:
✓ Connect the two door switches in parallel (1)
✓ in series with the battery and buzzer (1)
✓ Use reed switches / push-to-break / micro-switches on the doors (1)
